narration: [chintu] <bookmark mark='chintu'/>The diagonals meet at right angles, so it must be a square.
<bookmark mark='thin'/>Here one diagonal is much longer than the other, and the shape is no square.
<bookmark mark='strike'/>A square also needs equal diagonals, and we were not told that.

narration: <bookmark mark='one'/>Diagonals that cut each other in half at right angles always make a rhombus.
<bookmark mark='two'/>For a square, the diagonals must also be equal in length.
<bookmark mark='yours'/>Your turn. Diagonals of eight and six centimetres cut each other in half at right angles. Square, or rhombus?
